T_unknown
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2, as well as via cell population-specific integration and sub-clustering. These T cells either had heightened levels of platelet marker gene expression, or could not be confidently annotated as a specific T cell subtype.

labels.name: B_unknown
labels.rationale: B cells were identified via RCAv2, as well as via cell population-specific integration and sub-clustering. These B cells either had heightened levels of platelet marker gene expression, or could not be confidently annotated as a specific B cell subtype.

labels.name: Platelet
labels.rationale: Platelet cells were identified via RCAv2.

labels.name: memory_B_IGHMhi
labels.fullName: memory B cell, high IGHM expression
labels.rationale: B cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all B cells were performed, and clusters were annotated based on marker genes, particularly heightened levels of CD27, TNFRSF13B, and IGHM expression.

labels.name: memory_B_IGHMlo
labels.fullName: memory B cell, low IGHM expression
labels.rationale: B cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all B cells were performed, and clusters were annotated based on marker genes, particularly heightened levels of CD27 and TNFRSF13B and low levels of IGHM expression.

labels.name: atypical_B
labels.fullName: B cell, atypical, with expression of FCRL5, FGR, FCRL3
labels.rationale: B cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all B cells were performed, and clusters were annotated based on marker genes, particularly heightened levels of FGR and FCRL3 and / or FCRL5. These clusters are proximal to memory B cell clusters in gene expression space.

labels.name: CD14+_Monocyte
labels.rationale: Myeloid and pDC cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all myeloid and pDC cells were performed, and these clusters were manually annotated based on expression of CD14, and after examination of FCGR3A (CD16) expression.

labels.name: CD16+_Monocyte
labels.rationale: Myeloid and pDC cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all myeloid and pDC cells were performed, and these clusters were manually annotated based on expression of FCGR3A (CD16) and other marker genes. This annotation includes clusters that may contain intermediate monocytes.

labels.name: cDC2
labels.rationale: Myeloid and pDC cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all myeloid and pDC cells were performed, and these clusters were manually annotated based on expression of CLEC10A and other marker genes.

labels.name: CD16+_NK
labels.fullName: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
labels.ontologyTerm: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. NK clusters were annotated based on marker genes, as well as by the low numbers of TCR barcodes.

labels.name: CD8+_T_unknown
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. CD8+ T clusters were annotated based on marker genes. These CD8+ T cells could not be confidently annotated as a specific CD8+ T cell subtype.

labels.name: CD56+_NK
labels.fullName: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
labels.ontologyTerm: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. NK clusters were annotated based on marker genes, as well as by the low numbers of TCR barcodes.
synonyms: CD56-bright cytokine secreting natural killer cell

labels.name: CD4+_T_cyt
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify CD4+ T cells, and CD4+ T and dnT cells were further sub-clustered. CD4+ T clusters were annotated based on marker genes, particularly heightened levels of GZMB expression, as well as the presence of TCR barcodes.

labels.name: gdT_GZMBhi
labels.fullName: gamma-delta T cell, high GZMB expression
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. These clusters showed TRDV2, TRGV9, and GZMB expression.

labels.name: CD8+_T_GZMKhi
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. CD8+ T clusters were annotated based on marker genes, particularly heightened levels of GZMK expression, as well as the presence of TCR barcodes.

labels.name: gdT_GZMKhi
labels.fullName: gamma-delta T cell, high GZMK expression
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. These clusters showed TRDV2, TRGV9, and GZMK expression.

labels.name: CD8+_T_naive
labels.fullName: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. CD8+ T clusters were annotated based on marker genes.

labels.name: MAIT
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify non-CD4+ T cells as well as ILC and NK cells, and these cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. These clusters showed CD8A and TRAV1-2 expression, as well as TRAV1-2 gene usage in the TCR data.

labels.name: CD4+_T_naive
labels.fullName: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify CD4+ T cells, and CD4+ T and dnT cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. Clusters were annotated based on marker genes (e.g., CCR7), as well as low ITGB1 expression.

labels.name: CD4+_T_cm
labels.fullName: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify CD4+ T cells, and CD4+ T and dnT cells were further integrated and sub-clustered. Clusters were annotated based on marker genes (e.g., CCR7), as well as low expression of AIF1, BACH2, CCL5, and GZMK.

labels.name: Treg
labels.rationale: T and NK cells were identified via RCAv2. Integration and sub-clustering of all NK and T cells were performed to identify CD4+ T cells, and CD4+ T and dnT cells were further sub-clustered. These clusters showed heightened FOXP3 expression.
